held: This change is held, not done. It waits for the person's OK, which they give in their next message. Tell them in your own words what is waiting for their OK, naming the change plainly, and do not say it happened.
needs_private: That change needs the person's OK and cannot be asked for here: tell them to ask in a private conversation. It was not made.
too_long: That change is too long to show the person in full, so it cannot be asked for and was not made.
too_many: Too many changes are already waiting for the person's OK, so this one cannot be asked for and was not made.
agreeing_tainted: Agreeing is only done by the person's own message, after they have seen what is waiting. This message has read outside words, so nothing was agreed.
nothing_to_carry_out: Nothing is waiting for the person's OK that can be agreed now. Nothing ran.
not_run: not run: that tool is not offered in this conversation
carry_out_description: Carry out the changes that were held for the person's OK, exactly as what was shown waiting for their OK beside your earlier reply. Call it only when the person's latest message says yes to that. It takes no arguments and runs what was stored, nothing else.
history_line: [Shown beside your reply by the app, not said by you] {receipts}
history_facts: Shown to them to confirm or change with a tap, each by its label and the value you set: {items}
unavailable: That change could not be held right now, so it was not made.
unknown_recipient: That address is not one I was given, nor one this mailbox has written to before, so it waits for your OK
no_words: There are no words of yours here to check it against, so it waits for your OK
why_ran:
It was done without asking, because: {why}
Say in your own words what you changed and why.
history_agreed: [Shown beside their message by the app, not said by you] Carried out, as they agreed: {items}
history_agreed_interrupted: [Shown beside their message by the app, not said by you] Carrying out what they agreed to was interrupted, so it may or may not have been done.
